capabilities: Browse Microsoft To Do lists and smart views in a main window or side panel
Create, edit, complete, move and delete tasks with due dates, importance, subtasks, tags and notes
Turn notes or selected text into tasks and attach or insert links between notes and tasks
Search across all lists with filters for Today, Upcoming, Overdue and Completed
Sync changes bidirectionally with Microsoft To Do on other devices
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Sign-in credentials are stored in the vault's plugin folder, which matters when sharing vaults. Workaround documented for blocked sign-ins via a custom Azure app registration.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or manage tasks held in Microsoft To Do, so users must switch apps to check or update them.

relations.evidence: Everything stays in sync with Microsoft To Do on your phone, on the web and in Outlook.

summary: Microsoft To Do client inside Obsidian: browse lists, create, edit, complete and reopen tasks, and turn notes or selected text into linked tasks.
